controls.alpha_zero: same section at alpha 0; symmetric plate gives a jump near 0
controls.analytic_reference: thin-airfoil strip mean (reported ratio, not a pass gate: viscous sections at finite Re are expected to differ)

cost_estimate_note: cells only; run time must be measured on a small case by the solver owner

U_m_s.source: fin_mechanics example_request witness V (declared illustration); unsourced

alpha_deg.source: declared; v3a pose has the fin plane containing the stream, so its own alpha is 0

flow.alpha_eff_status: assumed (elliptic lifting line on a non-elliptic fan, AR 3.67)
flow.regime_gap: declared U is unsourced; flight/taxi regimes are not established; no free surface

frame_definition.fish_frame: x snout->tail, y left, z dorsal; snout at x=0

gates.sign: strip-mean jump p_ventral - p_dorsal > 0 for alpha > 0

grid.grid_pair: coarse t/2 and fine t/3 (ratio 1.5); both members of the pair pass the gate, so no coarse result is ever an unresolved one; fine costs 2.25x the cells

output_contract.per_section_file: case.json + surface rows, cfd3d 10-column float32 layout, one row per wall segment of the DORSAL face (normal +n), Cp_plus at +offset n, Cp_minus at -(offset + thickness) n, so both faces are sampled outside the wall
output_contract.transfer: engineering.coupled_mechanics.fin_patch.record_from_sections -> member-pressure/2 (dimensionality 2d-extrusion): each section's strip-mean jump times ray 0's own local width at that station (fin_geometry.tributary_v2), never a fan-mean width

purpose: resolve ray 0's membrane in chordwise sections so the two face pressures exist

section_geometry.plane: fin plane (panels.json fin_plane); chord along e_w = +x, normal n = e_w x e_u (dorsal)
section_geometry.solid: flat plate of thickness t_membrane over [leading edge, trailing edge] of the outline cut
section_geometry.thickness_status: assumed (components.json thickness_mm: membrane 0.10, ray_max 0.6; taper unknown)

solver_requirements.owner: cfd3d (claude-04) chooses the solver; dispatch by infra only
solver_requirements.reference_gate: the solver's own reference gate must be reported; cfd3d C1 sphere is FAILED as of Update 1 and that blocks any physical-validation wording
solver_requirements.thin_boundary: resolved solid, >= 2 cells across t_membrane; an immersed-boundary smoothing band wider than the plate is NOT resolution
